title: Admission guard before Begin reserves Begin's share of the shared budget (F3)
outcome: A slow named-root authority fence before Begin can no longer leave Begin with no time: the guard's deadline keeps Begin's share of the shared admission budget, and a guard that still runs out yields a definite NotStarted hold naming the guard. Lands after 1b, because it touches src/engram_host_adapter.rs.
acceptance: The named-root guard before Begin (src/engram_host_adapter.rs, guard_engram_root_read_until before TurnBegin) uses a deadline that reserves Begin's share of the shared admission budget, so a slow authority fence cannot leave Begin with no time. A fail-first test with a gated persist writer and a scripted clock (no load) shows the guard exhausting the budget on unchanged code; after the fix, Begin is still transmitted, or a definite NotStarted hold names the guard.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

The full gate's cargo-check stage on the exact committed tree prints no warnings; in particular, cargo check on the bin target reports no 'never used' warning for persist_delta_via_cache or persist_delta_with_fences.
